question: Q-004
reason: The criterion is satisfied. The registry in src/api/error-codes.ts holds exactly the 22 entries of the scenario with the statuses and messages given, and the named test asserts the scenario in full: it compares the sorted key set of ERROR_CODES with its 22 expected keys, deep-compares status and message of every entry, checks isRegisteredCode true for each of the 22 and false for cursor_invalid, the empty string and NOT_A_CODE. The key-set comparison alone would fail against the 16-entry registry of the base, so the test discriminates; the harness has no red record only because the task changed this frozen test in place, as the design records. The stale title (16 codes) is required by the task and does not affect what the test asserts.
